1	/-!
2	# Access kernel: state and derived notions
3	
4	Abstract authority machine of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`, Parts IV–VII:
5	frames (§39), places, leaves and footprints (§40), initialization states (§41), authorities
6	(§42), dynamic pinning obligations (§74, §75), the state `S3` (§38), the external contract `K`
7	(§48, §80), and the derived notions that the operations of §60–§75 read: usability (§40),
8	effective modes, exercisability and the grounding of a right (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3),
9	effective anchors and anchor order (§44), outcomes (§58).
10	
11	Identities of places and authorities are list indices; index order represents acyclicity of
12	parent and origin links (§49, last paragraph). Reading decisions are recorded in the reference
13	pass readings, never in this file.
14	-/
15	
16	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access
17	
18	/-! ## Frames (§39) -/
19	
20	/-- Frame stack `F` (§39): frame identities, current frame first; the parent of a frame is the
21	next element. -/
22	abbrev Frames := List Nat
23	
24	/-- `ancestor(f₁, f₂)` (§39): `f₁` is `f₂` or one of its ancestors in the stack. -/
25	def ancestor (F : Frames) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Prop := f₁ ∈ F.dropWhile (· != f₂)
26	
27	/-- Decidability of `ancestor` (§39). -/
28	instance (F : Frames) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Decidable (ancestor F f₁ f₂) :=
29	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∈ _))
30	
31	/-! ## Parent chains (§40, §42) -/
32	
33	/-- Strict ancestors of `i` along the link `org`, nearest first, within fuel `k` (§40 structural
34	parents, §42 origins). Only links to a smaller index are followed (§49, last paragraph). -/
35	def chainF (org : Nat → Option Nat) : Nat → Nat → List Nat
36	  | 0, _ => []
37	  | k + 1, i =>
38	    match org i with
39	    | some o => if o < i then o :: chainF org k o else []
40	    | none => []
41	
42	/-- Strict ancestors of `i` along `org` (§40, §42); fuel `i` suffices since the chain
43	decreases. -/
44	def chain (org : Nat → Option Nat) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chainF org i i
45	
46	/-! ## Places, leaves, footprints (§40) -/
47	
48	/-- Holder of an authority (§42) or owner of a place (§40): a frame or a place. -/
49	inductive Holder where
50	  | frame (f : Nat)
51	  | place (p : Nat)
52	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
53	
54	/-- Logical place (§40): optional structural parent, owner, abstract `kind`. Its identity is its
55	index in `P`; its death marker is `S3.dead`. -/
56	structure Place where
57	  parent : Option Nat
58	  owner : Holder
59	  kind : Nat
60	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
61	
62	/-- Structural parent of place `i` (§40). -/
63	def parentOf (P : List Place) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (P[i]?).bind (·.parent)
64	
65	/-- `partOf(p, q)` (§40): `p` is a place of `P` and `q` is `p` or one of its structural
66	ancestors. -/
67	def partOf (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop :=
68	  p < P.length ∧ (p = q ∨ q ∈ chain (parentOf P) p)
69	
70	/-- Decidability of `partOf` (§40). -/
71	instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (partOf P p q) :=
72	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))
73	
74	/-- Leaf (§40): a place with no structural child. -/
75	def isLeaf (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Prop := ∀ r < P.length, parentOf P r ≠ some l
76	
77	/-- Decidability of `isLeaf` (§40). -/
78	instance (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Decidable (isLeaf P l) :=
79	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _, _))
80	
81	/-- `footprint(q)` (§40): the leaves of `P` that are parts of `q`. -/
82	def footprint (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
83	  (List.range P.length).filter fun l => decide (isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q)
84	
85	/-- Two places overlap when their footprints share a leaf (§63.3). -/
86	def overlap (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := ∃ l ∈ footprint P p, l ∈ footprint P q
87	
88	/-- Decidability of `overlap` (§63.3). -/
89	instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (overlap P p q) :=
90	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∃ _ ∈ _, _))
91	
92	/-- `OwnedIn P src q` (§40, §33): the ownership chain of `q` reaches a place owned by `src` or by
93	one of its parts, that is, `q` is storage owned, directly or transitively, by the value at
94	`src`. -/
95	inductive OwnedIn (P : List Place) (src : Nat) : Nat → Prop where
96	  | direct {q o : Nat} {pl : Place} : P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o → partOf P o src →
97	      OwnedIn P src q
98	  | step {q o : Nat} {pl : Place} : P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o → OwnedIn P src o →
99	      OwnedIn P src q
100	
101	/-! ## State (§38, §41, §42) -/
102	
103	/-- Initialization state of a leaf (§41). -/
104	inductive InitSt where
105	  | uninit
106	  | init
107	  | moved
108	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
109	
110	/-- Mode of an authority or of a request (§42, §43). -/
111	inductive Mode where
112	  | observe
113	  | modify
114	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
115	
116	/-- Order of requested modes, `Observe ≤ Modify` (§43). -/
117	def Mode.le (m m' : Mode) : Prop := m = .observe ∨ m' = .modify
118	
119	/-- Decidability of the mode order (§43). -/
120	instance (m m' : Mode) : Decidable (m.le m') := inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∨ _))
121	
122	/-- Authority (§42): own mode, optional origin, footprint (a list of leaves read
123	extensionally), holder, activity. Its identity is its index in `A`. -/
124	structure Authority where
125	  mode : Mode
126	  origin : Option Nat
127	  footprint : List Nat
128	  holder : Holder
129	  active : Bool
130	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
131	
132	/-- Dynamic pinning obligation (§74, §75): the place `pin` was applied to, the leaves it pins, and
133	whether it is still active. Its identity is its index in `S3.pins`. -/
134	structure PinOb where
135	  place : Nat
136	  leaves : List Nat
137	  active : Bool
138	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
139	
140	/-- State `S3` (§38). `F`, `P`, `I`, `A`, `D` are the components of §38. `nF` (next fresh frame
141	identity, §39), `dead` (death marker of places, §40) and `pins` (dynamic pinning obligations,
142	§74, §75) are auxiliary information that creates no right (§38). -/
143	structure S3 where
144	  F : Frames
145	  nF : Nat
146	  P : List Place
147	  I : Nat → InitSt
148	  A : List Authority
149	  D : Nat → List Nat
150	  dead : Nat → Bool
151	  pins : List PinOb
152	
153	/-- Leaf `l` is dynamically pinned (§74): an active pinning obligation covers it. -/
154	def S3.pin (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Bool := s.pins.any fun o => o.active && o.leaves.contains l
155	
156	/-- Shape of the locals of `enterFrame` (§72) and of an allocation (§71.1): each element is an
157	optional structural parent (a place index) and a `kind`. Every element is owned by the holder
158	receiving the shape. -/
159	abbrev LocalShape := List (Option Nat × Nat)
160	
161	/-- External contract `K` (§48, §80): `DeclaredDisjoint` on regions (§23, §61.3);
162	`SharedMutable` and `Pinned` on leaves (§68.1, §63.5); `ExternalDone` on dynamic pinning
163	obligations, by identity (§75); `Deallocable` on places (§70.2); `FreeCompat place auth` (§70.2);
164	`Satisfiable provider shape s` (§71). Obligations of `K` are hypotheses of theorems, never
165	fields. -/
166	structure K where
167	  DeclaredDisjoint : List Nat → List Nat → Prop
168	  SharedMutable : Nat → Prop
169	  Pinned : Nat → Prop
170	  ExternalDone : Nat → Prop
171	  Deallocable : Nat → Prop
172	  FreeCompat : Nat → Nat → Prop
173	  Satisfiable : Nat → LocalShape → S3 → Prop
174	
175	/-- `DDSound(K)` (§80, §23): no declared disjointness relates two regions sharing a leaf. -/
176	def DDSound (k : K) : Prop := ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r'
177	
178	/-- `origin` link of authority `i` (§42). -/
179	def S3.org (s : S3) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.A[i]?).bind (·.origin)
180	
181	/-- Strict ancestors of authority `i` along its origin chain (§42, §43). -/
182	def S3.ancs (s : S3) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chain s.org i
183	
184	/-- Effective anchor of `x` (§44): the root reached along its origin chain, the last element of
185	`x :: s.ancs x`. -/
186	def S3.effAnchor (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Nat := (s.ancs x).getLastD x

188	/-- Active authority (§42); as an anchor, a valid anchor (§44). -/
189	def S3.Active (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Prop := ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ y.active = true
190	
191	/-- Decidability of `S3.Active` (§42, §44). -/
192	instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Decidable (s.Active x) :=
193	  match h : s.A[x]? with
194	  | some y => if hy : y.active = true then isTrue ⟨y, h, hy⟩
195	    else isFalse fun ⟨y', h', hy'⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact hy hy'
196	  | none => isFalse fun ⟨_, h', _⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'

198	/-- Current frame, the top of the stack (§39). -/
199	def S3.top (s : S3) : Nat := s.F.headD 0

201	/-! ## Decidable helpers -/
202	
203	/-- Predicate on an optional value, `P y` for `some y` and `d` for `none`; used to read the
204	components of `S3` (§38). -/
205	def OptP {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) : Prop :=
206	  match o with
207	  | some y => P y
208	  | none => d
209	
210	/-- Decidability of `OptP` (§38). -/
211	instance {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) [DecidablePred P] [Decidable d] :
212	    Decidable (OptP o P d) :=
213	  match o with
214	  | some y => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (P y))
215	  | none => inferInstanceAs (Decidable d)
216	
217	/-- An index with a value is in range (§38: identities are list indices). -/
218	theorem lt_of_getElem? {α : Type} {l : List α} {i : Nat} {x : α} (h : l[i]? = some x) :
219	    i < l.length := (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 h).1
220	
221	/-! ## Least fixed points on a bounded universe
222	
223	`Usable` (§40), `FrameOf` (§40), `OwnedIn` (§40) and `ExercisableAt` (§43) are inductive
224	predicates, each the least fixed point of a monotone rule over identities below a bound `n`; the
225	Kleene iteration is stable after `n + 1` steps, which makes them decidable. -/
226	
227	/-- `k`-th Kleene iterate of a rule `R` on Boolean predicates over `Nat` (decision procedure for
228	§40 and §43). -/
229	def kiter (R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool) : Nat → Nat → Bool
230	  | 0, _ => false
231	  | k + 1, a => R (kiter R k) a
232	
233	/-- A monotone rule whose conclusions lie below `n` and which reads its premise only below `n`
234	(decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
235	structure KRule (n : Nat) (R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool) : Prop where
236	  mono : ∀ p q : Nat → Bool, (∀ a, p a = true → q a = true) → ∀ a, R p a = true → R q a = true
237	  bound : ∀ p a, R p a = true → a < n
238	  loc : ∀ p q : Nat → Bool, (∀ a, a < n → p a = q a) → ∀ a, R p a = R q a
239	
240	/-- The iteration of a monotone rule is increasing (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
241	theorem kiter_mono {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
242	    ∀ k a, kiter R k a = true → kiter R (k + 1) a = true
243	  | 0, _, hk => by simp [kiter] at hk
244	  | k + 1, a, hk => h.mono _ _ (kiter_mono h k) a hk
245	
246	/-- Conclusions of the iteration lie below the bound (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
247	theorem kiter_bound {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
248	    ∀ k a, kiter R k a = true → a < n
249	  | 0, _, hk => by simp [kiter] at hk
250	  | _ + 1, a, hk => h.bound _ a hk
251	
252	/-- `countP` is monotone in the predicate (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
253	theorem countP_le_of {l : List Nat} {p q : Nat → Bool} (hpq : ∀ a ∈ l, p a = true → q a = true) :
254	    l.countP p ≤ l.countP q := by
255	  induction l with
256	  | nil => simp
257	  | cons a l ih =>
258	    simp only [List.countP_cons]
259	    have := ih fun b hb => hpq b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)
260	    cases hp : p a <;> cases hq : q a <;> simp_all <;> omega
261	
262	/-- `countP` grows strictly when one more element satisfies the predicate (decision procedure
263	for §40 and §43). -/
264	theorem countP_lt_of {l : List Nat} {p q : Nat → Bool} (hpq : ∀ a ∈ l, p a = true → q a = true)
265	    {x : Nat} (hx : x ∈ l) (hqx : q x = true) (hpx : p x = false) : l.countP p < l.countP q := by
266	  induction l with
267	  | nil => simp at hx
268	  | cons a l ih =>
269	    simp only [List.countP_cons]
270	    have hle := countP_le_of (l := l) fun b hb => hpq b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)
271	    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hx with rfl | hx
272	    · simp [hqx, hpx]; omega
273	    · have := ih (fun b hb => hpq b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)) hx
274	      cases hp : p a <;> cases hq : q a <;> simp_all <;> omega
275	
276	/-- A failed `all` has a witness (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
277	theorem all_false_exists {α : Type} {p : α → Bool} : ∀ {l : List α}, l.all p = false →
278	    ∃ a ∈ l, p a = false
279	  | [], h => by simp at h
280	  | a :: l, h => by
281	    simp only [List.all_cons, Bool.and_eq_false_iff] at h
282	    rcases h with h | h
283	    · exact ⟨a, List.mem_cons_self .., h⟩
284	    · obtain ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ := all_false_exists h; exact ⟨b, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb, hb'⟩
285	
286	/-- Stability of the iteration at step `k`, below `n` (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
287	def kstab (R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool) (n k : Nat) : Bool :=
288	  (List.range n).all fun a => kiter R (k + 1) a == kiter R k a
289	
290	/-- A stable iteration stays stable one step later (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
291	theorem kstab_succ {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) {k : Nat}
292	    (hs : kstab R n k = true) : kstab R n (k + 1) = true := by
293	  simp only [kstab, List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range, beq_iff_eq] at hs ⊢
294	  intro a ha
295	  show R (kiter R (k + 1)) a = R (kiter R k) a
296	  exact h.loc _ _ (fun b hb => hs b hb) a
297	
298	/-- A stable iteration stays stable (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
299	theorem kstab_le {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) {k : Nat}
300	    (hs : kstab R n k = true) : ∀ j, k ≤ j → kstab R n j = true
301	  | j, hj => by
302	    induction j with
303	    | zero => obtain rfl : k = 0 := by omega
304	              exact hs
305	    | succ j ih =>
306	      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (j + 1) with hlt | hge
307	      · exact kstab_succ h (ih (by omega))
308	      · obtain rfl : k = j + 1 := by omega
309	        exact hs
310	
311	/-- Before stabilizing, each step adds a conclusion (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
312	theorem kstab_exists {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
313	    ∀ k, (∃ j, j < k ∧ kstab R n j = true) ∨ k ≤ (List.range n).countP (kiter R k)
314	  | 0 => .inr (Nat.zero_le _)
315	  | k + 1 => by
316	    rcases kstab_exists h k with hj | hc
317	    · obtain ⟨j, hj, hs⟩ := hj; exact .inl ⟨j, by omega, hs⟩
318	    · cases hs : kstab R n k
319	      · obtain ⟨a, ha, hne⟩ := all_false_exists hs
320	        simp only [List.mem_range, beq_eq_false_iff_ne] at ha hne
321	        have hk : kiter R k a = false := by
322	          cases e : kiter R k a
323	          · rfl
324	          · exact absurd (kiter_mono h k a e) (by rw [e] at hne; simpa using hne)
325	        have hk1 : kiter R (k + 1) a = true := by
326	          cases e : kiter R (k + 1) a
327	          · rw [e, hk] at hne; exact absurd rfl hne
328	          · rfl
329	        have := countP_lt_of (l := List.range n) (fun b _ hb => kiter_mono h k b hb)
330	          (List.mem_range.2 ha) hk1 hk
331	        exact .inr (by omega)
332	      · exact .inl ⟨k, by omega, hs⟩
333	
334	/-- The iteration is stable from step `n + 1` on (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
335	theorem kiter_fix {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) (a : Nat) :
336	    kiter R (n + 2) a = kiter R (n + 1) a := by
337	  rcases kstab_exists h (n + 1) with ⟨j, hj, hs⟩ | hc
338	  · have hs' := kstab_le h hs (n + 1) (by omega)
339	    by_cases ha : a < n
340	    · simp only [kstab, List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range, beq_iff_eq] at hs'
341	      exact hs' a ha
342	    · cases e : kiter R (n + 2) a
343	      · cases e' : kiter R (n + 1) a
344	        · rfl
345	        · exact absurd (kiter_bound h _ a e') ha
346	      · exact absurd (kiter_bound h _ a e) ha
347	  · have := List.countP_le_length (p := kiter R (n + 1)) (l := List.range n)
348	    simp at this; omega
349	
350	/-- Monotonicity of the iteration over several steps (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
351	theorem kiter_mono_le {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
352	    ∀ j k a, kiter R k a = true → kiter R (k + j) a = true
353	  | 0, _, _, hk => hk
354	  | j + 1, k, a, hk => kiter_mono h _ a (kiter_mono_le h j k a hk)
355	
356	/-- The iteration is constant after step `n + 1` (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
357	theorem kiter_ge {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
358	    ∀ j, kiter R (n + 1 + j) = kiter R (n + 1)
359	  | 0 => rfl
360	  | j + 1 => funext fun a => by
361	    show R (kiter R (n + 1 + j)) a = kiter R (n + 1) a
362	    rw [kiter_ge h j]; exact kiter_fix h a
363	
364	/-- A conclusion reached at some step is reached at step `n + 1` (decision procedure for §40 and
365	§43). -/
366	theorem kiter_up {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
367	    ∀ k a, kiter R k a = true → kiter R (n + 1) a = true := by
368	  intro k a hk
369	  by_cases hkn : k ≤ n + 1
370	  · have := kiter_mono_le h (n + 1 - k) k a hk
371	    rwa [show k + (n + 1 - k) = n + 1 by omega] at this
372	  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, k = n + 1 + j := ⟨k - (n + 1), by omega⟩
373	    rwa [kiter_ge h j] at hk
374	
375	/-! ## Usable places (§40) -/
376	
377	/-- `Usable(s, p)` (§40, items 1–3): `p` exists, is not marked dead, and its owner is a frame of
378	the stack or a usable place. Inductive, so an ownership cycle makes no place usable (§40). -/
379	inductive S3.Usable (s : S3) : Nat → Prop where
380	  | frame {q f : Nat} {pl : Place} : s.P[q]? = some pl → s.dead q = false →
381	      pl.owner = .frame f → f ∈ s.F → S3.Usable s q
382	  | place {q o : Nat} {pl : Place} : s.P[q]? = some pl → s.dead q = false →
383	      pl.owner = .place o → S3.Usable s o → S3.Usable s q
384	
385	/-- A usable place exists (§40, item 1). -/
386	theorem S3.Usable.lt {s : S3} {q : Nat} (h : s.Usable q) : q < s.P.length := by
387	  cases h <;> exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
388	
389	/-- One step of `Usable` read on a Boolean premise (decision procedure for §40). -/
390	def usableR (s : S3) (U : Nat → Bool) (q : Nat) : Bool :=
391	  match s.P[q]? with
392	  | some pl => !s.dead q && match pl.owner with
393	    | .frame f => decide (f ∈ s.F)
394	    | .place o => decide (o < s.P.length) && U o
395	  | none => false
396	
397	/-- The place case of `usableR` (decision procedure for §40). -/
398	theorem usableR_place {s : S3} {U : Nat → Bool} {q o : Nat} {pl : Place} (hpl : s.P[q]? = some pl)
399	    (hd : s.dead q = false) (ho : pl.owner = .place o) (hlt : o < s.P.length) (hU : U o = true) :
400	    usableR s U q = true := by
401	  simp [usableR, hpl, hd, ho, hlt, hU]
402	
403	/-- `usableR` is a bounded monotone rule (decision procedure for §40). -/
404	theorem usableR_rule (s : S3) : KRule s.P.length (usableR s) where
405	  mono p q hpq a h := by
406	    unfold usableR at h ⊢; split at h
407	    · split at h <;> simp_all
408	    · exact h
409	  bound p a h := by
410	    unfold usableR at h; split at h
411	    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
412	    · cases h
413	  loc p q hpq a := by
414	    unfold usableR; split
415	    · split
416	      · rfl
417	      · rename_i o _; by_cases ho : o < s.P.length <;> simp [ho, hpq o]
418	    · rfl
419	
420	/-- Soundness of the iteration for `Usable` (decision procedure for §40). -/
421	theorem usable_of_kiter (s : S3) : ∀ k q, kiter (usableR s) k q = true → s.Usable q
422	  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
423	  | k + 1, q, h => by
424	    simp only [kiter, usableR] at h
425	    split at h
426	    · rename_i pl hpl
427	      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true'] at h
428	      obtain ⟨hd, h⟩ := h
429	      split at h
430	      · exact .frame hpl hd ‹_› (by simpa using h)
431	      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h
432	        exact .place hpl hd ‹_› (usable_of_kiter s k _ h.2)
433	    · cases h
434	
435	/-- `Usable` is computed by `|P| + 1` steps of `usableR` (decision procedure for §40). -/
436	theorem usable_iff {s : S3} {q : Nat} :
437	    s.Usable q ↔ kiter (usableR s) (s.P.length + 1) q = true := by
438	  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, usable_of_kiter s _ q⟩
439	  induction h with
440	  | frame hpl hd ho hf =>
441	    show usableR s _ _ = true
442	    simp [usableR, hpl, hd, ho, hf]
443	  | place hpl hd ho hu ih =>
444	    rw [← kiter_fix (usableR_rule s)]
445	    show usableR s _ _ = true
446	    exact usableR_place hpl hd ho hu.lt ih
447	
448	/-- Decidability of `Usable` (§40). -/
449	instance (s : S3) (q : Nat) : Decidable (s.Usable q) := decidable_of_iff _ usable_iff.symm
450	
451	/-- Live holder (§49.8): a frame of the stack or a usable place. -/
452	def HolderLive (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
453	  | .frame f => f ∈ s.F
454	  | .place p => s.Usable p
455	
456	/-- Decidability of `HolderLive` (§49.8). -/
457	instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderLive s h) := by
458	  cases h <;> unfold HolderLive <;> infer_instance
459	
460	/-! ## Frame of a place (§40, §44) -/
461	
462	/-- Frame ending the ownership chain of `q`, searched within `k` steps (`placeFrame`, §40). -/
463	def pframeF (s : S3) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
464	  | 0, _ => none
465	  | k + 1, q =>
466	    match s.P[q]? with
467	    | some pl =>
468	      match pl.owner with
469	      | .frame f => some f
470	      | .place o => pframeF s k o
471	    | none => none
472	
473	/-- `placeFrame(q)` (§40): the frame ending the ownership chain of `q`, within `|P| + 1`
474	steps. -/
475	def S3.pframe (s : S3) (q : Nat) : Option Nat := pframeF s (s.P.length + 1) q
476	
477	/-- Frame of a holder (§44): the frame itself, or the frame of the holding place. -/
478	def S3.hframe (s : S3) : Holder → Option Nat
479	  | .frame f => some f
480	  | .place p => s.pframe p
481	
482	/-- `FrameOf s q f` (§40, `placeFrame`; §49.3): the ownership chain of `q` is finite and ends at
483	frame `f`. -/
484	inductive FrameOf (s : S3) : Nat → Nat → Prop where
485	  | frame {q f : Nat} {pl : Place} : s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f → FrameOf s q f
486	  | place {q o f : Nat} {pl : Place} : s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o → FrameOf s o f →
487	      FrameOf s q f
488	
489	/-- A place with a frame exists (§40). -/
490	theorem FrameOf.lt {s : S3} {q f : Nat} (h : FrameOf s q f) : q < s.P.length := by
491	  cases h <;> exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
492	
493	/-- One step of `FrameOf s · f` read on a Boolean premise (decision procedure for §40). -/
494	def frR (s : S3) (f : Nat) (U : Nat → Bool) (q : Nat) : Bool :=
495	  match s.P[q]? with
496	  | some pl => match pl.owner with
497	    | .frame g => decide (g = f)
498	    | .place o => decide (o < s.P.length) && U o
499	  | none => false
500	
501	/-- `frR` is a bounded monotone rule (decision procedure for §40). -/
502	theorem frR_rule (s : S3) (f : Nat) : KRule s.P.length (frR s f) where
503	  mono p q hpq a h := by
504	    unfold frR at h ⊢; split at h
505	    · split at h <;> simp_all
506	    · exact h
507	  bound p a h := by
508	    unfold frR at h; split at h
509	    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
510	    · cases h
511	  loc p q hpq a := by
512	    unfold frR; split
513	    · split
514	      · rfl
515	      · rename_i o _; by_cases ho : o < s.P.length <;> simp [ho, hpq o]
516	    · rfl
517	
518	/-- `pframeF` is the iteration of `frR` (decision procedure for §40). -/
519	theorem pframeF_kiter (s : S3) (f : Nat) :
520	    ∀ k q, pframeF s k q = some f ↔ kiter (frR s f) k q = true
521	  | 0, q => by simp [pframeF, kiter]
522	  | k + 1, q => by
523	    simp only [pframeF, kiter, frR]
524	    split
525	    · split
526	      · simp
527	      · rename_i o _
528	        by_cases hlt : o < s.P.length
529	        · simp [hlt, pframeF_kiter s f k o]
530	        · simp only [hlt, decide_false, Bool.false_and]
531	          cases k with
532	          | zero => simp [pframeF]
533	          | succ k => simp [pframeF, List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (Nat.le_of_not_lt hlt)]
534	    · simp
535	
536	/-- Soundness of the iteration for `FrameOf` (decision procedure for §40). -/
537	theorem frameOf_of_kiter (s : S3) (f : Nat) : ∀ k q, kiter (frR s f) k q = true → FrameOf s q f
538	  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
539	  | k + 1, q, h => by
540	    simp only [kiter, frR] at h
541	    split at h
542	    · rename_i pl hpl
543	      split at h
544	      · rename_i g hg; simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at h; subst h; exact .frame hpl hg
545	      · rename_i o ho; simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h
546	        exact .place hpl ho (frameOf_of_kiter s f k o h.2)
547	    · cases h
548	
549	/-- `pframe` computes `FrameOf` (§40, `placeFrame`). -/
550	theorem pframe_iff {s : S3} {q f : Nat} : s.pframe q = some f ↔ FrameOf s q f := by
551	  rw [S3.pframe, pframeF_kiter]
552	  refine ⟨frameOf_of_kiter s f _ q, fun h => ?_⟩
553	  induction h with
554	  | frame hpl ho => exact kiter_up (frR_rule s _) 1 _ (by simp [kiter, frR, hpl, ho])
555	  | place hpl ho hf ih =>
556	    apply kiter_up (frR_rule s _) (s.P.length + 2) _
557	    show frR s _ (kiter (frR s _) (s.P.length + 1)) _ = true
558	    simp [frR, hpl, ho, ih, hf.lt]
559	
560	/-! ## Transitive ownership (§40) -/
561	
562	/-- One step of `OwnedIn P src` read on a Boolean premise (decision procedure for §40). -/
563	def owR (P : List Place) (src : Nat) (U : Nat → Bool) (q : Nat) : Bool :=
564	  match P[q]? with
565	  | some pl => match pl.owner with
566	    | .place o => decide (partOf P o src) || (decide (o < P.length) && U o)
567	    | .frame _ => false
568	  | none => false
569	
570	/-- A place owned through the value at `src` exists (§40). -/
571	theorem OwnedIn.lt {P : List Place} {src q : Nat} (h : OwnedIn P src q) : q < P.length := by
572	  cases h <;> exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
573	
574	/-- `owR` is a bounded monotone rule (decision procedure for §40). -/
575	theorem owR_rule (P : List Place) (src : Nat) : KRule P.length (owR P src) where
576	  mono p q hpq a h := by
577	    unfold owR at h ⊢; split at h
578	    · split at h
579	      · simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h ⊢
580	        rcases h with h | ⟨h1, h2⟩
581	        · exact .inl h
582	        · exact .inr ⟨h1, hpq _ h2⟩
583	      · exact h
584	    · exact h
585	  bound p a h := by
586	    unfold owR at h; split at h
587	    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
588	    · cases h
589	  loc p q hpq a := by
590	    unfold owR; split
591	    · split

598	    ∀ k q, kiter (owR P src) k q = true → OwnedIn P src q
599	  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h

602	    split at h
603	    · rename_i pl hpl
604	      split at h
605	      · rename_i o ho

618	  | direct hpl ho hp => exact kiter_up (owR_rule P src) 1 _ (by simp [kiter, owR, hpl, ho, hp])

628	/-! ## Effective modes (§43) -/
629	
630	/-- Modes of the active descendants of `a` whose footprint covers leaf `p` (§43). -/
631	def descModes (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : List Mode :=
632	  (List.range s.A.length).filterMap fun j =>
633	    match s.A[j]? with
634	    | some y => if y.active = true ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ a ∈ s.ancs j then some y.mode else none
635	    | none => none
636	
637	/-- Cases 2–4 of §43 for an active authority of own mode `m` covering the leaf, whose covering
638	active descendants have modes `ds`. -/
639	def effOf (m : Mode) (ds : List Mode) : Option Mode :=
640	  if ds = [] then some m else if Mode.modify ∈ ds then none else some .observe
641	
642	/-- `effective(s, a, l)` (§43, cases 1–4), computed per leaf. -/
643	def effective (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Option Mode :=
644	  match s.A[a]? with
645	  | some x => if x.active = true ∧ p ∈ x.footprint then effOf x.mode (descModes s a p) else none
646	  | none => none
647	
648	/-- Compatible effective modes for independent ordinary accesses: only `Observe`/`Observe`
649	(§50). -/
650	def Compat (m₁ m₂ : Mode) : Prop := m₁ = .observe ∧ m₂ = .observe
651	
652	/-- Effective mode `e` permits the requested mode `m`: present and not exceeded (§43). -/
653	def Allows (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Prop := OptP e (fun e => m.le e) False
654	
655	/-- Decidability of `Allows` (§43). -/
656	instance (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Decidable (Allows e m) := by
657	  unfold Allows; infer_instance
658	
659	/-- Footprint of authority `a` (§42), empty if it does not exist. -/
660	def S3.afp (s : S3) (a : Nat) : List Nat := match s.A[a]? with
661	  | some x => x.footprint
662	  | none => []
663	
664	/-- Adds an authority with fresh identity `s.A.length` (§42, §60). -/
665	def S3.addAuth (s : S3) (y : Authority) : S3 := { s with A := s.A ++ [y] }
666	
667	/-! ## Exercisable authorities (§43) -/
668	
669	/-- `ExercisableAt(s, a, m)` (§43): `a` is active, its own mode permits `m`, and it is held by
670	the current frame, or by a place `p` such that an authority itself exercisable at `m` has an
671	effective mode permitting `m` on every leaf of `p`. Inductive along the holder chain (§43), so no
672	holder cycle justifies a right. -/
673	inductive S3.ExercisableAt (s : S3) : Nat → Mode → Prop where
674	  | base {a : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → m.le y.mode →
675	      y.holder = .frame s.top → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
676	  | held {a p b : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
677	      m.le y.mode → y.holder = .place p → S3.ExercisableAt s b m →
678	      (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
679	
680	/-- One step of `ExercisableAt · m` read on a Boolean premise (decision procedure for §43). -/
681	def exR (s : S3) (m : Mode) (E : Nat → Bool) (a : Nat) : Bool :=
682	  match s.A[a]? with
683	  | some y => y.active && decide (m.le y.mode) && match y.holder with
684	    | .frame f => decide (f = s.top)
685	    | .place p => (List.range s.A.length).any fun b =>
686	        decide (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) && E b
687	  | none => false
688	
689	/-- `any` depends only on the values of the predicate on the list (decision procedure for
690	§43). -/
691	theorem any_congr' {α : Type} {f g : α → Bool} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ b ∈ l, f b = g b) →
692	    l.any f = l.any g
693	  | [], _ => rfl
694	  | a :: l, h => by
695	    simp only [List.any_cons, h a (List.mem_cons_self ..),
696	      any_congr' fun b hb => h b (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hb)]
697	
698	/-- `exR` is a bounded monotone rule (decision procedure for §43). -/
699	theorem exR_rule (s : S3) (m : Mode) : KRule s.A.length (exR s m) where
700	  mono p q hpq a h := by
701	    unfold exR at h ⊢; split at h
702	    · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h ⊢
703	      refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩; split at h
704	      · simpa using h.2
705	      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.any_eq_true] at h ⊢
706	        obtain ⟨b, hb, hc, he⟩ := h.2
707	        exact ⟨b, hb, hc, hpq b he⟩
708	    · exact h
709	  bound p a h := by
710	    unfold exR at h; split at h
711	    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
712	    · cases h
713	  loc p q hpq a := by
714	    unfold exR; split
715	    · congr 1; split
716	      · rfl
717	      · exact any_congr' fun b hb => by rw [hpq b (List.mem_range.1 hb)]
718	    · rfl
719	
720	/-- Soundness of the iteration for `ExercisableAt` (decision procedure for §43). -/
721	theorem exercisableAt_of_kiter (s : S3) (m : Mode) :
722	    ∀ k a, kiter (exR s m) k a = true → s.ExercisableAt a m
723	  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
724	  | k + 1, a, h => by
725	    simp only [kiter, exR] at h
726	    split at h
727	    · rename_i y hy
728	      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
729	      obtain ⟨⟨ha, hm⟩, h⟩ := h
730	      split at h
731	      · rename_i f hf; exact .base hy ha hm (by simp at h; rw [hf, h])
732	      · rename_i p hp
733	        simp only [List.any_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
734	        obtain ⟨b, -, hc, hb⟩ := h
735	        exact .held hy ha hm hp (exercisableAt_of_kiter s m k b hb) hc
736	    · cases h
737	
738	/-- The frame-held case of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
739	theorem exR_base {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a : Nat} {y : Authority}
740	    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode)
741	    (hf : y.holder = .frame s.top) : exR s m E a = true := by
742	  unfold exR; rw [hy]; simp [ha, hm, hf]
743	
744	/-- The place-held case of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
745	theorem exR_held {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a p b : Nat} {y : Authority}
746	    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode) (hp : y.holder = .place p)
747	    (hb : b < s.A.length) (hc : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m)
748	    (hE : E b = true) : exR s m E a = true := by
749	  simp only [exR, hy, ha, hp, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
750	    List.any_eq_true, List.mem_range]
751	  exact ⟨hm, b, hb, hc, hE⟩
752	
753	/-- `ExercisableAt` is computed by `|A| + 1` steps of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
754	theorem exercisableAt_iff {s : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} :
755	    s.ExercisableAt a m ↔ kiter (exR s m) (s.A.length + 1) a = true := by
756	  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, exercisableAt_of_kiter s m _ a⟩
757	  induction h with
758	  | base hy ha hm hf => exact exR_base hy ha hm hf
759	  | held hy ha hm hp hb hc ih =>
760	    rw [← kiter_fix (exR_rule s _)]
761	    have hb' := kiter_bound (exR_rule s _) _ _ ih
762	    exact exR_held hy ha hm hp hb' hc ih
763	
764	/-- Decidability of `ExercisableAt` (§43). -/
765	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (s.ExercisableAt a m) :=
766	  decidable_of_iff _ exercisableAt_iff.symm
767	
768	/-- `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43): the current frame has an authority exercisable at `m` whose
769	effective mode permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
770	def HasRight (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
771	  ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.ExercisableAt a m ∧
772	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s a l) m
773	
774	/-- Decidability of `HasRight` (§43). -/
775	instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Decidable (HasRight s m q) := by
776	  unfold HasRight; infer_instance
777	
778	/-- Authority `g` grounds the right `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3: "the
779	exercisable authority on which that right rests"): it is exercisable at `m` and its effective mode
780	permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
781	def Grounds (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) : Prop :=
782	  g ∈ List.range s.A.length ∧ s.ExercisableAt g m ∧
783	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s g l) m
784	
785	/-- Decidability of `Grounds` (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3). -/
786	instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) : Decidable (Grounds s m q g) := by
787	  unfold Grounds; infer_instance
788	
789	/-- Authority `j` is the grounding authority `g` or belongs to its origin chain (§63.4, §69.2,
790	§70.3: "the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain"). -/
791	def RightChain (s : S3) (g j : Nat) : Prop := j = g ∨ j ∈ s.ancs g
792	
793	/-- Decidability of `RightChain` (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3). -/
794	instance (s : S3) (g j : Nat) : Decidable (RightChain s g j) := by
795	  unfold RightChain; infer_instance
796	
797	/-! ## Dependencies and anchors (§44) -/
798	
799	/-- Anchors of the value at `q`, inherited from its parts (§44: dependencies of contained values
800	are accounted for transitively). -/
801	def depsOf (s : S3) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
802	  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r => decide (partOf s.P r q)).flatMap s.D
803	
804	/-- The anchors of every place containing leaf `p` are valid, that is, active (§44; §66.3,
805	§67.3, §68.3). -/
806	def DepsValid (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
807	  ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, partOf s.P p q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x
808	
809	/-- Decidability of `DepsValid` (§44). -/
810	instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (DepsValid s p) :=
811	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _ ∈ _, _))
812	
813	/-- The frame of the effective anchor of `x` (the frame of its holder) exists and is `fd` or an
814	ancestor of `fd` (§44). -/
815	def EffAnchorOK (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
816	  OptP (s.A[s.effAnchor x]?) (fun z => OptP (s.hframe z.holder)
817	    (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => ancestor s.F g f) False) False) False
818	
819	/-- Decidability of `EffAnchorOK` (§44). -/
820	instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (EffAnchorOK s x fd) := by
821	  unfold EffAnchorOK; infer_instance
822	
823	/-- `AnchorOrder` (§44, §54): for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable place `q`, the frame of the
824	effective anchor of `x` is the frame of `q` or an ancestor. -/
825	def AnchorOrder (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)
826	
827	/-- `AnchorOrder` read on the places of `P` (decision procedure for §44). -/
828	theorem anchorOrder_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrder s ↔
829	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q) :=
830	  ⟨fun h q _ hq => h q hq, fun h q hq => h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq⟩
831	
832	/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrder` (§44). -/
833	instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrder s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrder_iff.symm
834	
835	/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44, §54): the rule of `AnchorOrder` for every active authority held by a
836	usable place `q`. -/
837	def AnchorOrderHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
838	  ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
839	    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)
840	
841	/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A` (decision procedure for
842	§44). -/
843	theorem anchorOrderHeld_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrderHeld s ↔
844	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
845	      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
846	        EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)) True := by
847	  constructor
848	  · intro h q _ hq x _
849	    unfold OptP; split
850	    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy
851	    · trivial
852	  · intro h q hq x y hy ya hh
853	    have := h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
854	    simp only [OptP, hy] at this; exact this ya hh
855	
856	/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44). -/
857	instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrderHeld s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderHeld_iff.symm
858	
859	/-! ## Outcomes (§58) -/
860	
861	/-- `Outcome3 = ok(new_state) | reject | fail` (§58). `fail` leaves the state unchanged and
862	carries none. -/
863	inductive Outcome3 (σ : Type) where
864	  | ok (s : σ)
865	  | reject
866	  | fail
867	
868	/-- A kernel transition other than `alloc` (§58): `ok` with the effect when the preconditions
869	hold, `reject` otherwise; never `fail`. -/
870	inductive Guarded {σ : Type} (Pre : Prop) (eff : σ) : Outcome3 σ → Prop where
871	  | ok : Pre → Guarded Pre eff (.ok eff)
872	  | reject : ¬ Pre → Guarded Pre eff .reject
873	
874	end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic

/-!
# Access kernel: operations O1–O16

The sixteen kernel operations of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` §60–§75. Each
operation has a precondition structure with one named field per clause item (or per condition of
an item), each field citing its clause; a `Decidable` instance; an effect function; and a step
relation over `Outcome3` (§58). Every operation except `alloc` is `Guarded` (`ok` or `reject`);
`alloc` may also `fail` (§58, §71). `KStep` is the union of their `ok` transitions.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- `mapI f i l` applies `f` to each element of `l` with its index counted from `i` (used by the
effects of §72 and §73). -/
def mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) : Nat → List α → List β
  | _, [] => []
  | i, a :: l => f i a :: mapI f (i + 1) l

/-! ## O1 `derive` (§60) -/

/-- Effect of `derive(source, region, mode)` (§60, `ok` effect): a new active authority of fresh
identity, origin `src`, mode `m`, footprint `region`, held by the current frame. -/
def deriveEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
  s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, region, .frame s.top, true⟩

/-- Preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
structure DerivePre (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop where
  /-- §60.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : s.Active src
  /-- §60.1: `ExercisableAt(s, source, mode)`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src m
  /-- §60.1: every authority of the origin chain of `source`, its effective anchor included, is
  active. -/
  chainActive : ∀ x ∈ s.ancs src, s.Active x
  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` exist. -/
  leaves : ∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` belong to the footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src
  /-- §60.2: `mode` does not exceed the effective right of `source` on these leaves. -/
  modeOK : ∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m
  /-- §60.3: the addition preserves I1 (§50): an active authority outside the origin chain of the
  new one and sharing a leaf of `region` has own mode `Observe`, and so has the request. -/
  exclusive : ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
    b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
    True
  /-- §60.4: the new holding frame is the live current frame. -/
  frameLive : s.top ∈ s.F

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) :
    Decidable (DerivePre s src region m) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src m ∧ (∀ x ∈ s.ancs src, s.Active x) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m) ∧
    (∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
      b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
      True) ∧
    s.top ∈ s.F)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- `derive` as a relation (§60). -/
def DeriveStep (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DerivePre s src region m) (deriveEff s src region m)

/-! ## O2 `split` (§61) -/

/-- Effect of `split(source, regions)` (§61, `ok` effect): one active derived `Modify` authority
per region, held by the current frame. -/
def splitEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A ++ rs.map fun r => ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ }

/-- Exclusive right already distributed by `src` on leaf `p` (§61.3): an active `Modify`
descendant of `src` covering `p`. -/
def DistribExcl (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ src ∈ s.ancs j ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ y.mode = .modify)
    False

/-- Decidability of `DistribExcl` (§61.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Decidable (DistribExcl s src j p) := by
  unfold DistribExcl; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `split` (§61). §61.4 is not a precondition (see the note of §61). -/
structure SplitPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : Prop where
  /-- §61.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : s.Active src
  /-- §61.1: `source` is exercisable by the current frame in `Modify`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src .modify
  /-- §61.1: sufficient modification rights: effective `Modify` on every leaf of the regions. -/
  modifyOn : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify
  /-- §61.2: each region lies within the available footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none
  /-- §61.3: regions are pairwise disjoint, structurally or by `K.DeclaredDisjoint`. -/
  disjoint : rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')
  /-- §61.3: no exclusive right already distributed is overlapped. -/
  notDistributed : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `split` (§61). -/
instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (src : Nat)
    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (SplitPre k s src rs) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src .modify ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify) ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none) ∧
    rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r') ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩

/-- `split` as a relation (§61). -/
def SplitStep (k : K) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (SplitPre k s src rs) (splitEff s src rs)

/-! ## O3 `release` (§62) -/

/-- Effect of `release(authority)` (§62, `ok` effect): the authority becomes inactive and leaves
the anchors of its holding place. -/
def releaseEff (s : S3) (a : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { x with active := false }
      D := fun q => if x.holder = .place q then (s.D q).filter (· != a) else s.D q }
  | none => s

/-- Right of the current frame on a holder (§62.2): the current frame itself, or a place on which
the current frame has exercisable `Modify`. -/
def HolderRight (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame f => f = s.top
  | .place p => HasRight s .modify p

/-- Decidability of `HolderRight` (§62.2). -/

    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩⟩

/-- `store` as a relation (§65). -/
def StoreStep (a p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)

/-! ## Shapes (§47, §71.1, §72) -/

/-- A local shape as a shape whose elements have no owning element (§71.1, §72: locals and
allocated storage are owned by the receiving holder). -/
def LocalShape.toShape (ls : LocalShape) : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) :=
  ls.map fun e => (e.1, none, e.2)

/-- Owner of element `i` of a shape (§47, §72, §71): its owning element if any, `hd`
otherwise. -/
def shapeOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (hd : Holder) (i : Nat) : Holder :=
  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
  | some o => .place o
  | none => hd

/-- Places `P` followed by the elements of a shape (§47, §71, §72): (parent, owning element,
kind), owned by their owning element or by `hd`. -/
def shapeP (P : List Place) (hd : Holder) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
    List Place :=
  P ++ (List.range ls.length).map fun i =>
    ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), shapeOwner ls hd i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩

/-- Well-formed shape at offset `n` (§72.2, §71.1; for statics, the hypothesis recorded for
§47): the parent and the owning element of an element are earlier elements, and a part has the
owning element of its parent. -/
def ShapeOK (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∀ i ∈ List.range ls.length,
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)) (fun r => n ≤ r ∧ r < n + i ∧
      (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = (ls[r - n]?).bind (·.2.1)) True ∧
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1)) (fun o => n ≤ o ∧ o < n + i) True

/-- Decidability of `ShapeOK` (§72.2, §71.1). -/
instance (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Decidable (ShapeOK n ls) := by
  unfold ShapeOK; infer_instance

/-- Indices of the root elements (no parent) of a shape (§40 root places; §47, §71, §72). -/
def rootIdx (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Nat :=
  (List.range ls.length).filter fun i => ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)).isNone

/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` (§72) -/

/-- Places after `enterFrame` (§72, `ok` effect): the locals appended, owned by the new frame. -/
def enterP (s : S3) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place := shapeP s.P (.frame s.nF) ls.toShape

/-- Effect of `enterFrame(params, locals)` (§72, `ok` effect): a new frame `nF` is pushed; the
parameters are now held by it; locals are appended (uninitialized, no anchor, alive) with one
active root `Modify` authority per root local, held by the new frame; pinning obligations are
unchanged. -/
def enterEff (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : S3 :=
  { F := s.nF :: s.F, nF := s.nF + 1, P := enterP s ls
    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
    A := mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) 0 s.A ++
      (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
        ⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i),
          shapeOwner ls.toShape (.frame s.nF) i, true⟩
    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q
    pins := s.pins }

/-- Origin protection on entry for parameter `p` in state `s'` (§72.3): if `p` is a `Modify`
authority with direct origin `o`, `o` is exercisable in no mode. -/
def ParamOriginHidden (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s'.A[p]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify →
    OptP y.origin (fun o => ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .observe ∧ ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .modify) True) True

/-- Decidability of `ParamOriginHidden` (§72.3). -/
instance (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (ParamOriginHidden s' p) := by
  unfold ParamOriginHidden; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` (§72). The modes/footprints/parameter-passing part of §72.2 is
not represented. -/
structure EnterPre (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- §72.1: the calling frame, the current frame, is live. -/
  callerLive : s.F ≠ []
  /-- §72.1: each parameter is an active derived authority held by the caller. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top ∧
    y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- §72.2: the locals form a well-formed shape (each parent is an earlier local). -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- §72.3: origin protection on entry, in the resulting state. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p
  /-- §72.4: `AnchorOrderHeld` over the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `enterFrame` (§72). -/
instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Decidable (EnterPre s ps ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.F ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
      y.holder = .frame s.top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p) ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `enterFrame` as a relation (§72). -/
def EnterStep (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (EnterPre s ps ls) (enterEff s ps ls)

/-! ## O7 `exitFrame` (§73) -/

/-- Authority `x` survives the exit to stack `F₀` (§73.4): active and held by a surviving frame
or by a usable place whose terminal owner survives. -/
def Survives (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ HolderLive { s with F := F₀ } y.holder) False

/-- Decidability of `Survives` (§73.4). -/
instance (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Decidable (Survives s F₀ x) := by
  unfold Survives; infer_instance

/-- First surviving authority of a list (§73.4). -/
def firstSurv (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (l : List Nat) : Option Nat :=
  l.find? fun z => decide (Survives s F₀ z)

/-- Authority `a` after the exit (§73, `ok` effect): released unless it survives; a surviving
derived authority is reanchored to the first surviving active origin of its chain. -/
def exitG (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (a : Nat) (y : Authority) : Authority :=
  if Survives s F₀ a then
    match y.origin with
    | none => y
    | some _ => { y with origin := firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a) }
  else { y with active := false }

/-- Effect of `exitFrame` (§73, `ok` effect): the current frame is popped; authorities that do
not survive are released; surviving derived authorities and the anchors of `D` are reanchored to
the first surviving authority of their chains. -/
def exitEff (s : S3) : S3 :=
  { s with
    F := s.F.tail
    D := fun q => (s.D q).map fun x => (firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x)).getD x
    A := mapI (exitG s s.F.tail) 0 s.A }

/-- Preconditions of `exitFrame` (§73). The result clause of §73.2 is not represented. -/
structure ExitPre (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop where
  /-- §73.1: the current frame is not the initial frame and has a surviving caller. -/
  hasCaller : s.F.tail ≠ []
  /-- §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
  authority among itself and its origins. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x) ≠ none
  /-- §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives s s.F.tail a → s.org a ≠ none →
    firstSurv s s.F.tail (s.ancs a) ≠ none
  /-- §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned, statically or
  dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q →
    ¬ ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
  /-- §73.5: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (exitEff s)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `exitFrame` (§73). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) : Decidable (ExitPre k s) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.F.tail ≠ [] ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives s s.F.tail a → s.org a ≠ none →
      firstSurv s s.F.tail (s.ancs a) ≠ none) ∧

    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `exitFrame` as a relation (§73). -/
def ExitStep (k : K) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (ExitPre k s) (exitEff s)

/-- Releases every authority whose holder is no longer live (§69, §70 `ok` effects). -/
def cleanup (s : S3) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A.map fun y => if HolderLive s y.holder then y else { y with active := false } }

/-! ## O12 `endUse` (§69) -/

/-- `endUse p` before releasing authorities whose holder died (§69, `ok` effect): the leaves of
`p` become `Uninit`; authorities held within `p` are released; anchors of `p` and its parts are
removed; storage owned by `p`, transitively, is marked dead. -/
def endUseS (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P p then .uninit else s.I l
    D := fun q => if partOf s.P q p then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => s.dead q || decide (OwnedIn s.P p q)
    A := s.A.map fun y => if heldIn s.P p y.holder then { y with active := false } else y }

/-- Effect of `endUse p` (§69, `ok` effect): `endUseS`, then the authorities whose holder died
are released. -/
def endUseEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 := cleanup (endUseS s p)

/-- Leaf whose use ends with the value at `p` (§69.2, §69.4): a leaf of `p` or of storage that
stops being usable. -/
def EndingLeaf (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Prop :=
  l ∈ footprint s.P p ∨ (isLeaf s.P l ∧ s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (endUseS s p).Usable l)

/-- Decidability of `EndingLeaf` (§69). -/
instance (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Decidable (EndingLeaf s p l) := by
  unfold EndingLeaf; infer_instance

/-- Root authority of the value at `p` (§69.3): an authority with no origin covering a leaf of
`p`. -/
def IsRootOf (s : S3) (p : Nat) (y : Authority) : Prop :=
  y.origin = none ∧ ∃ l ∈ footprint s.P p, l ∈ y.footprint

/-- Decidability of `IsRootOf` (§69.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) (y : Authority) : Decidable (IsRootOf s p y) := by
  unfold IsRootOf; infer_instance

/-- Authority `j` does not block `endUse p` (§69.2): if it is an active derived authority over an
ending leaf, it is held within `p` or its holder dies. -/
def EndUseAccessOK (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
    (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, EndingLeaf s p l) →
      heldIn s.P p y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder) True

/-- Decidability of `EndUseAccessOK` (§69.2). -/
instance (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseAccessOK s p j) := by
  unfold EndUseAccessOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Anchor `x` survives `endUse p` (§69.3): not held within `p`, not a root of `p`, with a holder
that stays live. -/
def EndUseAnchorOK (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ heldIn s.P p y.holder ∧ ¬ IsRootOf s p y ∧
    HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder) True

/-- Decidability of `EndUseAnchorOK` (§69.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseAnchorOK s p x) := by
  unfold EndUseAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `endUse` (§69). -/
structure EndUsePre (k : K) (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §69.1: `place` is usable. -/
  usable : s.Usable p
  /-- §69.1: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p
  /-- §69.2: no active derived authority over an ending leaf is held outside the dying places,
  except the authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `place`: some
  authority grounding that right and its origin chain. -/
  access : ∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ EndUseAccessOK s p j
  /-- §69.2, last sentence: no authority that the effect makes inactive has an active descendant
  that the effect does not make inactive. -/
  keptDesc : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
    ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active j
  /-- §69.3: no place usable after the effect depends on an authority held by `place`, its root,
  or an authority whose holder dies. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s p).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q, EndUseAnchorOK s p x
  /-- §69.4: no ending leaf, owned storage included, is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `endUse` (§69). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (EndUsePre k s p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ EndUseAccessOK s p j) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
      ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active j) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s p).Usable q →
      ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q, EndUseAnchorOK s p x) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩

/-- `endUse` as a relation (§69). -/
def EndUseStep (k : K) (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (EndUsePre k s p) (endUseEff s p)

/-! ## O13 `free` (§70) -/

/-- The holder is a place (§70.1). -/
def Holder.isPlace : Holder → Bool
  | .place _ => true
  | .frame _ => false

/-- `OwnedRoot` (§70.1): a place with no structural parent, owned by a place. -/
def OwnedRoot (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.P[p]?) (fun pl => pl.parent = none ∧ pl.owner.isPlace = true) False

/-- Decidability of `OwnedRoot` (§70.1). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (OwnedRoot s p) := by
  unfold OwnedRoot; infer_instance

/-- Place `q` belongs to the unit released by `free p` (§70): a part of `p`, or storage owned by
`p`, transitively. -/
def FreedPlace (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := partOf P q p ∨ OwnedIn P p q

/-- Decidability of `FreedPlace` (§70). -/
instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (FreedPlace P p q) := by
  unfold FreedPlace; infer_instance

/-- `free p` before releasing authorities whose holder died (§70, `ok` effect): the released unit
is marked dead; authorities covering it, roots included, or held within `p` become inactive. -/
def freeS (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    dead := fun q => s.dead q || decide (FreedPlace s.P p q)
    A := s.A.map fun y =>
      if (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∨ heldIn s.P p y.holder then
        { y with active := false } else y }

/-- Effect of `free p` (§70, `ok` effect): `freeS`, then the authorities whose holder died are
released. -/
def freeEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 := cleanup (freeS s p)

/-- Leaf of the released unit (§70.3, §70.4): a leaf of `p` or of storage that stops being
usable. -/
def FreedLeaf (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Prop :=
  l ∈ footprint s.P p ∨ (isLeaf s.P l ∧ s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (freeS s p).Usable l)

/-- Decidability of `FreedLeaf` (§70). -/
instance (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Decidable (FreedLeaf s p l) := by
  unfold FreedLeaf; infer_instance

/-- Authority `j` does not block `free p` (§70.3): if it is an active derivative over the
footprint being freed, it is held within `p` or its holder dies. -/
def FreeAccessOK (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
    (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedLeaf s p l) →
      heldIn s.P p y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (freeS s p) y.holder) True

/-- Decidability of `FreeAccessOK` (§70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Decidable (FreeAccessOK s p j) := by
  unfold FreeAccessOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Anchor `x` survives `free p` (§70.3): it covers no leaf of the released unit, is not held
within `p`, and its holder stays live. -/
def FreeAnchorOK (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P p y.holder ∧
    HolderLive (freeS s p) y.holder) True

/-- Decidability of `FreeAnchorOK` (§70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Decidable (FreeAnchorOK s p x) := by
  unfold FreeAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `free p auth` (§70). -/
structure FreePre (k : K) (s : S3) (p auth : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §70.1: `place` is an `OwnedRoot`. -/
  ownedRoot : OwnedRoot s p
  /-- §70.2: `K.Deallocable(place)`. -/
  deallocable : k.Deallocable p
  /-- §70.2: `K.FreeCompat(place, auth)`. -/
  freeCompat : k.FreeCompat p auth
  /-- §70.3: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p
  /-- §70.3: no active derivative over the footprint being freed is held outside dying holders,
  except the authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `place`: some
  authority grounding that right and its origin chain. -/
  access : ∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ FreeAccessOK s p j
  /-- §70.3, last sentence: no authority that the effect makes inactive has an active descendant
  that the effect does not make inactive. -/
  keptDesc : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
    ¬ (freeEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (freeEff s p).Active j
  /-- §70.3: no surviving place is anchored to an authority of the released unit or of its dead
  holders. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (freeS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, FreeAnchorOK s p x
  /-- §70.4: no leaf of the released unit is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, FreedLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `free` (§70). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
    [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] (s : S3) (p auth : Nat) :
    Decidable (FreePre k s p auth) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OwnedRoot s p ∧ k.Deallocable p ∧ k.FreeCompat p auth ∧
    HasRight s .modify p ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ FreeAccessOK s p j) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
      ¬ (freeEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (freeEff s p).Active j) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (freeS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, FreeAnchorOK s p x) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, FreedLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- `free` as a relation (§70). -/
def FreeStep (k : K) (p auth : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (FreePre k s p auth) (freeEff s p)

/-! ## O14 `alloc` (§71) -/

/-- Static preconditions of `alloc provider owner shape` (§71, items 1–3). -/
structure AllocStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- §71.1: the shape is nonempty. -/
  nonempty : ls ≠ []
  /-- §71.1: the shape is represented like the locals of `enterFrame` (each parent is an earlier
  element). -/
  shapeOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- §71.1 with the `ok` outcome of §71 ("a new storage root"): exactly one element has no
  parent. -/
  oneRoot : (rootIdx ls.toShape).length = 1
  /-- §71.2: the provider is a usable place. -/
  providerUsable : s.Usable provider
  /-- §71.2: all leaves of the provider are `Init`. -/
  providerInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init
  /-- §71.2: metadata updates are permitted through exercisable `Modify` on the provider or a
  valid `writeShared` (§68) over its leaves. -/
  providerRight : HasRight s .modify provider ∨
    ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)
  /-- §71.3: exercisable `Modify` over `owner`. -/
  ownerRight : HasRight s .modify owner
  /-- §71.3 (liveness restrictions): `owner` is usable. -/
  ownerUsable : s.Usable owner

/-- Decidability of the static preconditions of `alloc` (§71). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat)
    (ls : LocalShape) : Decidable (AllocStatic k s provider owner ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (ls ≠ [] ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧ (rootIdx ls.toShape).length = 1 ∧
    s.Usable provider ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init) ∧
    (HasRight s .modify provider ∨
      ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)) ∧
    HasRight s .modify owner ∧ s.Usable owner)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- Places after `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): the elements of the shape appended, owned by
`owner`. -/
def allocP (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place :=
  shapeP s.P (.place owner) ls.toShape

/-- Effect of `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): a new storage root of fresh identities owned by
`owner`, its leaves `Uninit`, no anchor, alive, with a root `Modify` authority with no origin held
by `owner`; pinning obligations are unchanged. -/
def allocEff (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : S3 :=
  { s with
    P := allocP s owner ls
    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
    A := s.A ++ (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (allocP s owner ls) (s.P.length + i),
        shapeOwner ls.toShape (.place owner) i, true⟩
    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q }

/-- `alloc provider owner shape` as a relation (§71 outcomes, §58): `reject` when a static
precondition fails; `fail`, state unchanged, when `K.Satisfiable` is false; `ok` otherwise. -/
inductive AllocStep (k : K) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (s : S3) :
    Outcome3 S3 → Prop where
  | ok : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
      AllocStep k provider owner ls s (.ok (allocEff s owner ls))
  | fail : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → ¬ k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
      AllocStep k provider owner ls s .fail
  | reject : ¬ AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → AllocStep k provider owner ls s .reject

/-! ## O15 `pin`, O16 `unpin` (§74, §75) -/

/-- Preconditions of `pin` (§74). "Applicable pinning obligations" is not represented. -/
structure PinPre (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §74: `place` is usable. -/
  usable : s.Usable p
  /-- §74: exercisable `Modify` over the leaves of `place`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `pin` (§74). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (PinPre s p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `pin` (§74, `ok` effect): an active dynamic pinning obligation of fresh identity
`|pins|` is installed on the leaves of `place`. -/
def pinEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with pins := s.pins ++ [⟨p, footprint s.P p, true⟩] }

/-- `pin` as a relation (§74). -/
def PinStep (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (PinPre s p) (pinEff s p)

/-- Effect of `unpin` (§75, `ok` effect): the designated obligation `o` ends, and only that
one. -/
def unpinEff (s : S3) (o : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with pins := s.pins.modify o fun ob => { ob with active := false } }

/-- Preconditions of `unpin o` (§75), `o` the identity of a dynamic pinning obligation. -/
structure UnpinPre (k : K) (s : S3) (o : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §75: `unpin` designates an active dynamic pinning obligation. -/
  active : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => ob.active = true) False
  /-- §75: `place`, on which the obligation was installed by `pin`, is usable. -/
  usable : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => s.Usable ob.place) False
  /-- §75: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
  right : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => HasRight s .modify ob.place) False
  /-- §75: `K.ExternalDone`, applied to the obligation. -/
  externalDone : k.ExternalDone o

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `unpin` (§75). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] (s : S3) (o : Nat) :
    Decidable (UnpinPre k s o) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => ob.active = true) False ∧
    OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => s.Usable ob.place) False ∧
    OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => HasRight s .modify ob.place) False ∧ k.ExternalDone o)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩

/-- `unpin` as a relation (§75). -/
def UnpinStep (k : K) (o : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (UnpinPre k s o) (unpinEff s o)

/-! ## Kernel steps (§57, §58) -/

/-- One `ok` transition of a kernel operation O1–O16 (§60–§75; §57 reachability). -/
inductive KStep (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
  | derive {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode} :
      DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | split {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} :
      SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | release {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | transfer {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | depend {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} : DependStep q x s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | enter {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | exit {s s' : S3} : ExitStep k s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | read {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | write {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | writeShared {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | pin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : PinStep p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | unpin {s s' : S3} {o : Nat} : UnpinStep k o s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | endUse {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | free {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | alloc {s s' : S3} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | store {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} : StoreStep a p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-!
# Access kernel: steps, reachable states and the main invariant

Assembles the per-operation results of `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.*` into the statements of
§57, §58 and §59 of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`:

* kernel operations O1–O16 as data, their outcome relation, and the correspondence of `KStep` and
  `Reachable` with the labelled steps and their reflexive-transitive closure (§57, §58);
* preservation of `KInv` (§57) by every step, `transfer` (§63) included, from states satisfying
  `KInv` and the auxiliary `HeldAnchored`; preservation of the auxiliaries `KAux` and
  `HeldAnchored` by every step; preservation of `I5` (§57) by every step from a `WF3` state;
* the initial state satisfies the invariant and the auxiliaries under `StaticsOK` (§47), and its
  `Init` leaves are the declared ones;
* the main invariant on reachable states (§57, `reachable_kinv`) and `I5` on reachable states
  (`reachable_i5`); the ownership-cycle run of §63 is rejected by §63.9
  (`reachable_cycle_rejected`);
* §59: only writes and transfers make a leaf `Init`, and every `Init` leaf of a reached state was
  declared or written on the run; §39: frame 0 stays at the bottom of the stack; §58: only `alloc`
  fails.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Kernel operations as data (§58, §60–§75) -/

/-- A kernel operation O1–O16 with its arguments (§60–§75). -/
  | .depend q x => DependStep q x
  | .enter ps ls => EnterStep ps ls
  | .exit => ExitStep k
  | .read a ls => Read3Step a ls
  | .write a ls => Write3Step a ls
  | .writeShared a ls => WriteSharedStep k a ls
  | .pin p => PinStep p
  | .unpin o => UnpinStep k o
  | .endUse p => EndUseStep k p
  | .free p auth => FreeStep k p auth
  | .alloc pr ow ls => AllocStep k pr ow ls
  | .store a p => StoreStep a p

/-- A kernel step is the `ok` outcome of some operation O1–O16 (§57, §58). -/
theorem kstep_iff {k : K} {s s' : S3} : KStep k s s' ↔ ∃ op : KernelOp, op.Step k s (.ok s') := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h with
    | derive h => exact ⟨.derive _ _ _, h⟩
    | split h => exact ⟨.split _ _, h⟩
    | release h => exact ⟨.release _, h⟩
    | transfer h => exact ⟨.transfer _ _, h⟩
    | depend h => exact ⟨.depend _ _, h⟩
    | enter h => exact ⟨.enter _ _, h⟩
    | exit h => exact ⟨.exit, h⟩
    | read h => exact ⟨.read _ _, h⟩
    | write h => exact ⟨.write _ _, h⟩
    | writeShared h => exact ⟨.writeShared _ _, h⟩
    | pin h => exact ⟨.pin _, h⟩
    | unpin h => exact ⟨.unpin _, h⟩
    | endUse h => exact ⟨.endUse _, h⟩
    | free h => exact ⟨.free _ _, h⟩
    | alloc h => exact ⟨.alloc _ _ _, h⟩
    | store h => exact ⟨.store _ _, h⟩
  · rintro ⟨op, h⟩
    cases op with
    | derive => exact .derive h
    | split => exact .split h
    | release => exact .release h
    | transfer => exact .transfer h
    | depend => exact .depend h
    | enter => exact .enter h
    | exit => exact .exit h
    | read => exact .read h
    | write => exact .write h
    | writeShared => exact .writeShared h
    | pin => exact .pin h
    | unpin => exact .unpin h
    | endUse => exact .endUse h
    | free => exact .free h
    | alloc => exact .alloc h
    | store => exact .store h

/-- Finite runs of kernel steps from `s` (§57): the reflexive-transitive closure of `KStep`. -/
inductive KStar (k : K) (s : S3) : S3 → Prop where
  /-- The empty run (§57). -/
  | refl : KStar k s s
  /-- A run followed by one kernel step (§57). -/
  | tail {t u : S3} : KStar k s t → KStep k t u → KStar k s u

/-- The reachable states of §57 are the states reached from `S3.init statics` by a finite run of
kernel steps. -/
theorem reachable_iff {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} :
    Reachable k statics s ↔ KStar k (S3.init statics) s := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction h with
    | init => exact .refl
    | step _ h ih => exact .tail ih h
  · intro h
    induction h with
    | refl => exact .init
    | tail _ h ih => exact .step ih h

/-! ## Outcomes (§58) and the base frame (§39) -/

/-- Only `alloc` may produce `fail` among O1–O16 (§58). -/
theorem op_fail_only_alloc {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s : S3} (h : op.Step k s .fail) :
    ∃ pr ow ls, op = .alloc pr ow ls := by
  cases op with
  | alloc pr ow ls => exact ⟨pr, ow, ls, rfl⟩
  | _ => exact (Alloc.guarded_ne_fail h).elim

/-- No kernel step changes the bottom of the frame stack (§39: the base frame never exits). -/
theorem kstep_base {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KStep k s s') : s'.F.getLast? = s.F.getLast? := by
  cases h with
  | derive h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | split h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | release h =>
    rename_i a
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
  | transfer h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | depend h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | enter h => exact enter_keeps_base h
  | exit h => exact (exit_keeps_base h).2
  | read h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | write h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | writeShared h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | pin h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | unpin h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | endUse h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | free h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | alloc h => cases h with | ok => rfl
  | store h =>
    rename_i a p
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    unfold storeEff; split <;> rfl

/-- On every reachable state, the bottom of the stack is the base frame 0 (§39, §47). -/
theorem reachable_base {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (h : Reachable k statics s) :
    s.F.getLast? = some 0 := by
  induction h with
  | init => rfl
  | step _ h ih => rw [kstep_base h]; exact ih

/-- The base frame 0 is never removed from the stack of a reachable state (§39). -/
theorem reachable_base_mem {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (h : Reachable k statics s) :
    0 ∈ s.F :=
  List.mem_of_getLast? (reachable_base h)

/-! ## Preservation by every step (§57, §58) -/

/-- Every operation, `transfer` included, preserves `KInv` (§57) from a state satisfying `KInv`
and the auxiliary `HeldAnchored` (not a clause of §57, used by `transfer`, §63) to its `ok`
outcome, under `DDSound` (§80, used by `split`, §61). -/
theorem op_preserves {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s)
